Package de.hof.dms.domain

Class FolderAcl

java.lang.Object
de.hof.dms.domain.FolderAcl
public class FolderAcl extends Object
Access-control list embedded in a Folder (and in DocumentRecord). It names the owner and owning department, and lists the users, roles and departments allowed access together with the concrete permission flags in FolderAccess. When inheritFromParent is true the effective permissions are derived from the parent folder rather than from this list.
